Job Title

SRE Engineer

Job Summary

Job Description


What You'll Do:


  • Provide SRE leadership across Telstra Inventory platforms (TNI, Cramer-LI and TPD), ensuring reliable, resilient and efficient production services.
  • Lead multi-location engineering and operations teams, setting priorities, support coverage and effective ways of working.
  • Drive service reliability and continuous improvement, reducing customer-impacting incidents, improving recovery and strengthening resilience.
  • Lead complex incident troubleshooting and response, including blameless post-incident reviews and permanent remediation of recurring issues.
  • Partner with business, architecture, engineering, DevOps and operations teams to manage priorities, risks and dependencies.
  • Identify and drive automation opportunities across operational tasks, reporting, remediation and support processes to reduce manual effort.
